answers.core: You have to rewrite the entire signal editing workflow to have something vaguely similar to this, and you will need to write a lot of repeated script methods (similar vein to the way we could have export categories in scripts for godot 3).
answers.workaround:
I see it as being used extremely often, especially if more than 1 person is working on the game. This goes towards not having to write dedicated level editors for games that would not need that support otherwise.

This is not just a replacement for scripts, but also for documentation that no longer needs to be written. (document which methods can be connected to, and which signals are safe to use)

title: Ability to hide methods from the "connect signal" window
